name: code_generation
description: Given an execution plan step + feature spec + project context, produces file changes (create/edit/delete). Respects existing code conventions and generates inline documentation per Engineering Law 6. Every output file carries a traceable origin.

inputs.name: plan_step
inputs.description: A single step from the execution plan { step_id, capability_id, inputs }

inputs.name: feature_spec
inputs.description: FeatureSpec from feature module if this step implements a feature.

inputs.name: project_context
inputs.description: Brain graph slice and existing file paths for convention awareness.

outputs.name: changes
outputs.description: [{ file_path, operation: create|edit|delete, content, diff_summary, trace_back: {plan_step_id, capability_id} }]

side_effects: Writes files to disk (through the kernel for change approval first)

error_codes.message: Plan step would produce zero file changes.
error_codes.recovery: Return empty changes list; do not create empty files (Constitution Principle 15).

error_codes.message: create operation on an existing path blocked.
error_codes.recovery: Suggest edit instead; never silently overwrite (Law 4).

error_codes.message: Target path is in a read-only module (kernel/runtime/constitution).
error_codes.recovery: Refuse to modify; surface the immutable module id (Law 16).

examples: plan_step from goal_decomposition with capability_id=code_generation -> creates 3 files with trace_back to the step.
